J10 table prints 120/208VAC while J10 Rule states 115/200 V RMS 400Hz Y/grounded neutral up to 10A per phase.
Two J11 Rules print 13.5.2.13.1-1/-2 despite actual §13.5.2.14; the -1 ID also appears within J10, separate stable source IDs retained.
J11 270VDC table 10A nominal differs from allowed 15A 2-second inrush; safety and wiring are source design conditions.
J12 DS101 non-GPS uses differential TIA485-A B/E, while J13 GPS uses TIA232 RTS/CTS/RX/TX.
Printed Rule13.5.2.16-5 has no SHALL; two RTS/CTS signal roles described.
MT source 24 physical positions, 12 RX and 12 TX labels; conditional three Fat Pipes group these same positions.
J14 >24 fibers is SHOULD Recommendation, J15 <=24 fibers is source Observation, two separate source Rule families regulate arrangements.
J14 original common Rule references 13.5.3.5-3, 13.5.2.5-7 and 13.5.2.16.1-2/-3/-4; J14/J15 other Rules refer 13.2.5.17.1-1. Literal original references unresolved.
V_BATT table 3.3V vs 3.5V maximum Rule, ALT_V_BATT 3.9V max; each 115mA, supplies platform clock/memory and key-fill support, not charged battery.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Physical constituent
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: J14 four-MT and J15 one-MT are distinct physical connector designs.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No installed sensing components or universal DIM chassis.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Network-visible participant
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: MT fiber channels can carry physical optical traffic.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No IP participant, network service identity or reachable CSAPI node.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Network instance and connection context
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: Three Fat Pipes group selected physical optical pin positions.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No actual network connection or negotiated remote endpoint.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Reported output field
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: 24 physical fiber positions are organized as RX/TX contacts.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Not 24 digital outputs, observations or individually identified physical sensors.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Declared component capability catalogue
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: J10 AC, J11 HVDC and J16 hold-up power are source-specific design capabilities.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Not an active capability observed on empirical cases.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Declared command interface
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: Physical DS101 key-fill signal interfaces differ by GPS role.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No authenticated CSAPI software Command or safe network execution API.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Component capability and readiness report
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: J16 battery-designated low-current hold-up is a hardware provision.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No source-reported readiness or actual device condition.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Required and recommended capability support
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: J10 protective, J11 wire and J14 fiber-count guidance are SHOULD Recommendations.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Not universal mandatory Profile SHALL or required connector.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Negotiated message encoding and model version
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: J12 differential TIA485-A and J13 single-ended TIA232 are native physical interfaces.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No machine-readable data model or digital schema negotiation.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Component time basis and synchronization
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: J16 hold-up can sustain a real-time clock over power cycles.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Not clock synchronization, measured accuracy or actual timestamp.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Reported physical parent/child attachment relationships
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: J14 and J15 specify possible physical mating arrangements.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No named installed parent/child devices or actual mechanical attachment.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Power-source classification
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: The source distinguishes platform AC, 270VDC and two backup DC feeds.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Not actual source generator or field battery identity.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Source-side AC voltage
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: J10 requires 115/200V RMS, while its table prints 120/208VAC.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No measured voltage and source discrepancy unresolved.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Load-side AC voltage
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: J10 governs AC input connection.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No observed internal load-side AC voltage.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Source-side DC voltage
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: J11 270VDC plus J16 3.3/3.9V backup inputs carry physical input specifications.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Not measured source-side voltage or actual charge.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Load-side DC voltage
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: J11 specifies platform DC power inputs.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Not real load-side sampled output.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Reported condition of power to the component
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: J11 inrush and J16 hold-up provisions constrain design.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Not current device power condition or measured electrical fault.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Reported energy reserve relative to maximum capacity
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: J16 battery-named backup is a platform-supplied input.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No measured state-of-charge or energy reserve.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Estimated time to empty under expected usage
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: Source describes retention power over a cycle.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No known capacity, discharge model or runtime forecast.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Request access-control metadata
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: Key-fill connector supports physical key provisioning.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No authenticated online API access-control metadata.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: REVIEW HOLD — reporting path
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: MT optical interfaces carry physical signaling possibilities.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No observed stream, registered route or live CSAPI DataStream.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: REVIEW HOLD — power / state
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: Source distinguishes HVDC inrush and 2 independent small hold-up power feeds.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No physical measurements, installed equipment state or adopted universal requirement.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: REVIEW HOLD — time / QA
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: J16 input is intended to preserve real-time clocks.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No actual UTC, clock uncertainty or observation QA evidence.

qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: REVIEW HOLD — control execution
qualified_existing_row_mappings.source_native_meaning: J12 wake-up Rule and J13 RTS/CTS labeled description are hardware-interface semantics.
qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No authenticated software request, acknowledgement or verified device effect.

exact_holds.description: J10 120/208VAC table differs from 115/200V RMS numbered Rule; no silent normalization.
J11 source prints 13.5.2.13.1-1/-2 Rule identifiers despite §13.5.2.14, with duplicated -1 printed for J10 and J11.
J11 270VDC@10A source table differs from 15A/2s inrush Rule; no measured electrical data.
J10/J11 connector figure pixels and exact modality checkmarks are not source-verified.
Original military 270VDC/power/grounding/SAE wire references are pointers, not independently audited normative documents.
J11 arc-track/corona Recommendations are design safety guidance, not proven installed conformance.
J12/J13 external EKMS308/DS101/TIA232/TIA485/MIL-STD464C originals not examined.
J12 differential non-GPS signals and J13 TIA232 GPS keyfill remain physically distinct.
J13 Rule13.5.2.16-5 is printed as Rule but lacks explicit SHALL; classified separately.
Physical key-fill interfaces do not imply an online security service, retrieved keys or authorized software Commands.
J14 Rule13.5.2.17.1-1 references 13.5.3.5-3 and 13.5.2.16.1-2/-3/-4; original referent validation held.
J14/J15 source points to Rule13.2.5.17.1-1; possible source numbering inconsistency remains held.
J14 more-than-24 fiber choice is SHOULD; J15 24-or-fewer choice is Observation, not mandatory design.
J14/J15 Observations print Inspection(I) but are not transformed into Rules.
24 original MT table pin/fiber positions and three Fat Pipes read as text; figure geometry/modalities held.
Original IEC61754-5 MT ferrule standard and eight figure pixels were not inspected.
J16 table 3.3V versus Rule 3.5V maximum for V_BATT, ALT_V_BATT 3.9V; not a measured voltage.
J16 platform power to clocks/keys does not establish a serialized battery, charge or time-to-empty.
Eight C239-native DSDM/IDL/OpenAPI, S251 and restricted Appendix C remain unreviewed/restricted.
No four source cases demonstrate installed J10–J16 hardware, actual keyfill, or safety conformance.
Zero adopted DIM classes/cardinality, Profile SHALL, commands or independent runtime interoperability.
